description: Deterministic minimized Node.js repository tasks for Rapture performance research substrate validation.

tasks.title: Make decimal money parsing exact
tasks.prompt: Fix parseAmountToCents so ordinary decimal strings are converted exactly, invalid formats are rejected, and safe integer bounds are preserved.

metadata.representativeReason: Exact money parsing is a common boundary bug with correctness and safety implications.
metadata.validatorEstablishes: Decimal semantics, rejected ambiguous formats, negative values, and safe range behavior.
metadata.limitations: Does not cover currencies or arbitrary precision beyond safe integer cents.

tasks.title: Add deterministic tiered discounts
tasks.prompt: Extend priceAfterDiscount with threshold tiers, stable integer rounding, policy validation, and no mutation of caller data.

metadata.representativeReason: Small pricing features combine specification interpretation, validation, and integer arithmetic.
metadata.validatorEstablishes: Tier selection at boundaries, fallback policy, input validation, and immutability.
metadata.limitations: Only integer percentage tiers are represented.

tasks.title: Deduplicate concurrent idempotent operations
tasks.prompt: Repair IdempotencyRegistry so concurrent calls for one key share one in-flight operation while failures remain retryable.

metadata.representativeReason: Concurrency repair exercises race reasoning and retry safety in ordinary service code.
metadata.validatorEstablishes: Concurrent same-key calls execute once and return the same result.
metadata.limitations: The registry is process-local and does not prove durable external idempotency.

tasks.title: Refactor order normalization into explicit results
tasks.prompt: Refactor normalizeOrder to avoid input mutation and return deterministic structured success or validation errors.

metadata.representativeReason: This is a contract-preserving refactor with error-shape and immutability requirements.
metadata.validatorEstablishes: Normalized success values, ordered error records, and caller-input immutability.
metadata.limitations: It validates a compact order model rather than a full API schema.

tasks.title: Preserve comment markers inside quoted values
tasks.prompt: Fix parseConfig so # starts a comment only outside quoted strings while malformed lines still fail.

metadata.representativeReason: Parser edge cases require local algorithm repair and careful malformed-input behavior.
metadata.validatorEstablishes: Quoted # preservation, trailing comments, ordinary parsing, and malformed-line rejection.
metadata.limitations: Escaped quote syntax is outside this minimized format.

tasks.title: Implement immutable recursive configuration merge
tasks.prompt: Implement recursive object merge, array replacement, and deep immutability for base and override inputs.

metadata.representativeReason: Deep merge is a small feature whose aliasing and collection semantics often cause regressions.
metadata.validatorEstablishes: Recursive objects, array replacement, and absence of mutable aliases to inputs.
metadata.limitations: Special objects and cyclic graphs are not supported.

tasks.title: Correct configuration source precedence
tasks.prompt: Trace the configuration loader and correct precedence to defaults < file < environment < CLI without changing merge semantics.

metadata.representativeReason: The task requires following imports and understanding a repository-level policy rather than editing a named arithmetic function.
metadata.validatorEstablishes: The documented four-source precedence chain for overlapping and retained keys.
metadata.limitations: Only the loader order is accepted; environment coercion is not represented.

tasks.title: Repair public TypeScript declarations
tasks.prompt: Align the package declaration file with the JavaScript runtime so strict TypeScript consumers can pass numeric timeouts and receive a typed endpoint object.

metadata.representativeReason: Declaration/runtime drift is a common library maintenance task requiring build-tool feedback.
metadata.validatorEstablishes: A strict consumer program typechecks against the declared input and output contracts.
metadata.limitations: The compact fixture does not measure a large compiler graph.
